verdict.rationale: Docs detail multi-GPU DGX B200 systems (8x B200 GPUs, 1,440GB memory), 5th-gen NVLink switches with 14.4TB/s aggregate bandwidth, DGX SuperPOD rack-scale turnkey infrastructure, and Mission Control for AI-factory-scale operations, plus community confirmation that B200 performs well and is used at scale including NVLink-based multi-GPU fabric management. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark validation of claimed 3X/15X performance figures at true multi-rack scale.
